sections.title: Class Objectives (as seen in the Blueprint):

• Learn about the components of a JAGGAER Advantage Instance

1. Familiarize yourself with the questions in the JLL Client Business Insights form

sections.title: Be Aware:
paragraphs: • Creation of the Admin Account (aka Guru) also creates the first Organization
• Most regions prefer to keep this organization for use by the Admin user only
• Only one Admin exists for each instance.
• User rights are hardcoded and cannot be managed in User Management within the Instance.
• Additional “Buyer Organizations” maybe be created by the creation of a Super User in the console.
• For each Buyer Organization created, there is one Super User allocated.
• User rights are hardcoded and cannot be managed in User Management within the Instance.

sections.title: Initial Site Request: Agreements, Branding, & Homepage
Initial Instance Activation: User Agreement (UA)
paragraphs: • A user agreement is the list of terms and conditions that each supplier must accept at the time of registration
• The UA ensures that Suppliers accept all of the terms & conditions levied by the Client, before proceeding with registration
• Client’s are provided with the JAGGAER standard UA, which may be edited
• The UA must be agreed upon before Activation Form submittal

sections.title: Initial Instance Activation: Code of Conduct
paragraphs: • A Code of Conduct outlines the ethical principles that govern decisions and behavior surrounding an organization
• These policies promote transparency and accountability, maintain trust, and warn against all fraudulent and illegal activities.
• Multiple documents can be configured, each with their own confirmation step
• The Code of Conduct and any related documents must be agreed upon before Activation Form submittal
